about:
CKC Automation was founded in 2005 in Benicia, California, as a multidisciplinary engineering and manufacturing partner specializing in industrial automation. The company operates from a single integrated facility in the Bay Area, combining machine design, controls engineering, data systems, and UL 508A-certified control panel fabrication under one roof.

The firm’s core offerings span three pillars: custom machine design-build, including robotic work cells and build-to-print equipment; high-volume contract manufacturing of control panels and electrical subsystems from its UL 508A panel shop; and controls and data services that collect, analyze, and visualize production data for real-time decision making. Its Benicia facility houses engineering offices, a certified panel shop, assembly space, and testing and validation areas, enabling close collaboration between design and build teams.

CKC serves manufacturers across the Bay Area and West Coast, delivering end-to-end automation solutions from concept through commissioning. While the company does not publicly list specific verticals, its case studies and client references indicate work with leading manufacturers seeking to optimize throughput, quality, and efficiency.

The company emphasizes a “right-sized” model that blends Silicon Valley innovation with world-class engineering standards, offering local responsiveness and end-to-end partnership. A 2024 merger with DST expanded its resource base while preserving its founding principles of engineering excellence and client partnership.
